corrections.reason: The standard Ge'ez construct noun for 'table/revelation of chapter headings' is መክሥተ (with 6th-order ክ), which matches the printed glyph.
The printed numeral is a single glyph ፵ (verse 40 of Luke 2, preceding verse ፵፩ on line 19); the wide box of ፵ was misread as two numerals ፵፬.
Visually and philologically this is verse ፴፫ (33) of Luke 4 (between verse ፴፩ on line 35 and verse ፴፰ on line 41); ink bleed at the bottom of ፴ made it look like ፵.
